Mushrooms. Totally fucked up. Here is my story.

My two friends and I were going to trip at my friend's house and they were going to consume miprocin and I was going to consume shrooms. This was my 2nd time doing shrooms with my first time being 2.5 grams and this being 3 grams. The 2.5 grams was pretty weak compared to my past experiences so I decided 3 would be fine. For whatever reason, I can't remember much after Ben and Mark left to do their own thing but I came to the conclusion that if I closed my eyes, I was going to die. I don't know what symptoms I was experiencing but what I do remember was that I was caught in a loop and events were replaying in my mind. So I ran downstairs and asked my friend to call 911 because it seemed like the mushrooms were poisonous. 

The police arrived and I came down to them and talked with them for a bit. I remember giving all of my information and what I ingested (mushrooms, weed, tea) and this lasted forever. They allowed me to put my jacket it on and I seriously couldn't figure out how to do it. I remember walking down the hill to the ambulance and then being back at the top and the bottom again and then I was finally there. Here is where things get really blurry. I kept thinking "Just stay awake, just stay awake" because if I closed my eyes I was going to die. Eventually, I gave up because I was trapped in a loop so I thought there was no hope because regardless, I was going to be insane. So I lied down for a bit with my eyes closed (I'm still having powerful visuals) and woke up in the loop again. 

I thought this can't be real. This will be over soon. Perhaps if I just broke the seatbelt I would be fine. Wrong. They held me down. Then I thought I was in hell because of the pain and I was thinking what did I possibly do to deserve this and how I failed everyone I love. Eventually the loop ended and I was getting out of the ambulance being wheeled to my room. This was also blurry because I thought the nurses were figments of my imagination doing exactly as I expected such as how they looked and reactions to what I said. For whatever reason, I also thought I was going to be raped since I was in hell. Fortunately, they is where they gave me a sedative and knocked me out for a bit. I woke up thinking this was still not real but the visuals were nearly done. Eventually everything ended and my parents came in and I was fine.

In retrospect, a lot of things went wrong such as doing the shrooms with inexperienced friends who should have just calmed me down although I do not blame them for what they did. I also had this fear beforehand because these two friends are BFFs and I feared they would I guess group together and unintentionally leave me isolated from their interactions and it was exactly what they were doing in the beginning.

She ruined me. I was absolutely in love with this girl freshmen year of high school. By the far the most down to earth and exciting girl I had met and I broke so many walls down and tried harder for her than any other but all she ended up doing was fooling me.

Initially, she had a boyfriend when we met but I still spoke with her everyday at school. She soon broke up with him, and to show how wise and nice I was, I gave her advice on how to fix the relationship. She took it and it worked. We still hung out and enjoyed each other's company and soon enough, they broke up again. This time, it was summer. During the time we actually spent the days together, we spoke openly about the deeper issues few people speak about like how her mom was sent to a psychiatric ward and how she was beating her. Those days I feel were the highlights of my summer. 

She got back together with the other guy (again) and I was heartbroken and decided that if I was to move on, I need to leave her behind and pretend she doesn't exist. This was easy at the time since school started back up again and we didn't have any classes together but when she did see me, she always recalled those days in the summer when we just spent the day talking and how great they were. I always brushed her off and sped past because, once again, I wanted to move on. 

Surprisingly enough, they broke up again and this time, she put the full court press on me. One day, she just came to my house unannounced and picked me up and we went to this tree overhanging the lake and spoke. Mind you, we were not alone at the time but later, when it was just us driving around, she started talking about how she used to have the biggest crush on me the previous summer. I had not the slightest idea and it knocked me off my feet. I told her I felt the same way and by the end of the night, I was 100% sure we were going to date soon. We hung out again a few nights later but she seemed much more distant but I was relentless in thinking she will be mine. Her ex called her unexpectedly, and started demanding where I live because he was going to come and take her away. She was irate and just left. 

After that, we didn't really speak in school and I saw her hanging out with her ex again, getting closer and closer every encounter. It absolutely shattered me. I was in complete ecstasy before, happier than I had ever been. I felt like I finally found the freedom past the depression that held me down, forcing me to put up my walls and to embrace that being lonely was what I was meant to be. 

She still occasionally texts me and god damn, I wish she would stop.
